origin: Unmodified minified npm dependency; no old application source or patches copied.
runtime: Optional MSE MPEG-TS/FLV transmuxer, not a software codec decoder. Requires feature-gated loading and getFeatureList().mseLivePlayback for live streams; native playback remains available without modern APIs. Browser and device codec/CORS restrictions still apply.

verification.syntheticStreams: 8-second H264/AAC 320x180 25fps streams generated locally using ffmpeg. HTTP TS and FLV each fail native playback with MediaError code 4 and then decode with mpegts.js, currentTime > 0.3s, audio and video metadata present, no player or page errors.
verification.scope: Standalone upstream dependency proof. Not an LG firmware test or real provider acceptance.
